card.name: Long-a letters inside transliterated Sanskrit and Persian
card.fires_on: The accented letter a (ā or â) inside romanized Sanskrit, Buddhist, or Old and Middle Persian terms. It also fires on broken-up pieces of such letters.

modes.label: Buddhist Sanskrit terms
modes.description: Macron or circumflex a inside transliterated Yogācāra and Buddhist terms.

modes.label: Persian and Avestan names
modes.description: Long a inside romanized Iranian words and etymologies, such as Baghdad or Avestan phrases.

card.plain: It marks the accented letter a inside Sanskrit and Persian words written in Latin letters, as in articles on Buddhism or Iranian names.
